mapper.sql: id, meeting_id, room_id, audio_file_id, transcript_source, duration_ms, ai_status, summary_json, ai_model, ai_error, ai_attempts, ai_started_at, ai_finished_at, asr_status, asr_task_id, asr_error, asr_attempts, asr_started_at, asr_finished_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM meeting_minutes WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_minutes (meeting_id, room_id, audio_file_id, transcript_source, duration_ms, ai_status, created_by) VALUES (#{meetingId}, #{roomId}, #{audioFileId}, #{transcriptSource}, #{durationMs}, #{aiStatus}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE meeting_minutes SET ai_status = 10, ai_error = NULL, ai_attempts = 0, ai_started_at = NULL, ai_finished_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND ai_status IN (0, 30, 40)
UPDATE meeting_minutes SET ai_status = 20, ai_started_at = #{startedAt}, ai_finished_at = NULL, ai_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND ai_status = 10

UPDATE meeting_minutes SET ai_status = 30, summary_json = #{summaryJson}, ai_model = #{model}, ai_finished_at = #{finishedAt}, ai_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND ai_status = 20
AND ai_started_at = #{startedAt} AND ai_started_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM meeting_minutes WHERE ai_status = 10 ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM meeting_minutes WHERE ai_status = 20 AND (ai_started_at IS NULL OR ai_started_at < #{before}) ORDER BY ai_started_at LIMIT #{limit}
